selection_metric: Steady-state spend-guard upper-bound USD per environment control step, including 2 CPU cores, 8 GiB RAM and the guard's 10% margin
scope: 8192 Go1JoystickFlatTerrain environments, held zero policy actions, episode autoreset, 20 control steps per synchronized call; 120 seconds measured after warmup. This measures physics/environment throughput, not full PPO training throughput.
